entities.summary: Mateus Vicente de Oliveira (1706–1786) was a Portuguese architect. He studied under the architects João Frederico Ludovice and Jean Baptiste Robillon during the construction of the royal palace at Mafra – Portugal's attempt to rival the Spanish king's palace at Escorial.
